# **Master Project Document: CareCateringApp**

Project: CareCateringApp (Centralized Hospital Logistics System)

Author: Randy Beltran

![][image1]

## **1\. Executive Summary**

**CareCateringApp** is a centralized, digital logistics platform designed specifically for Box Hill Hospital. It bridges the operational gap between Wards, the Kitchen, and the Store Supply chain.

* **The Problem:** Current operations rely on disjointed emails and blind physical rounds, leading to "Double Handling" (duplicate deliveries), lack of inventory visibility, and patient safety risks due to unstructured dietary requests.  
* **The Solution:** A unified Progressive Web App (PWA) where nurses place orders, and the system intelligently routes them to either the **Store Man** (Groceries) or the **Menu Monitor** (Patient Food), with real-time status tracking.

## **2\. Functional Modules**

### **2.1. Ward Groceries (Supply Chain)**

* **Custom Catalogs:** Wards only view items approved for their location (e.g., Clinical Wards vs. Admin Offices).  
* **Budget Control:** Items flagged as requires\_approval trigger an automatic email to the Ward's Financial Approver before the order is released.  
* **Templates:** Admin can deploy new wards instantly using "Setup Templates" (e.g., "Standard Surgical Ward Kit").

### **2.2. Patient Catering (Clinical Safety)**

* **Unified Diet Rules:** A master system for managing all food rules.  
  * **Primary Diet:** Single selection (e.g., "Diabetic", "Texture C").  
  * **Dietary Flags:** Multi-select options for Allergies (e.g., "Gluten") and Dislikes (e.g., "No Onion").  
* **Safety First:** Mandatory fields for Bed Number and Diet Code.  
* **Time Rules:** Automated "Cut-off times" disable hot food options after specific hours, offering cold alternatives automatically.

### **2.3. The "Proactive" Store Man (Gap Analysis)**

Transforms the Store Man from a delivery driver to an inventory auditor.

* **Logic:** The system stores a "Par Level" (Ideal Stock) for every item in every ward.  
* **Workflow:** Store Man inputs current shelf count $\\rightarrow$ System calculates the gap $\\rightarrow$ Auto-generates a proactive\_restock order.

### **2.4. Dispatcher Console (Kitchen Tower Control)**

A "Split-View" dashboard for the Kitchen Supervisor.

* **Traffic Control:** Visualizes incoming Groceries vs. Diets.  
* **Drag & Drop:** Allows manual reassignment of tasks (e.g., assigning a grocery run to a kitchen runner during peak times).

## **3\. Technical Architecture**

We utilize a modern, type-safe, serverless stack to ensure speed, reliability, and low maintenance.

| Component | Technology | Reasoning |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Frontend** | **Next.js (React)** | Server-Side Rendering for speed; responsive design for Tablets/Desktops. |
| **Language** | **TypeScript** | Strict type safety to prevent runtime errors in a clinical environment. |
| **Styling** | **Tailwind CSS** | Rapid UI development with a clean, medical-grade aesthetic. |
| **Backend** | **Supabase** | Provides Database, Auth, and APIs out-of-the-box. |
| **Database** | **PostgreSQL** | Relational integrity for complex medical/inventory data. |
| **Realtime** | **Websockets** | Instant order updates on Kitchen screens without refreshing. |

## **4\. Database Schema (ERD)**

The following diagram represents the final data structure, featuring the unified DIET\_CODES table for simplified management of diets, allergies, and dislikes.

erDiagram  
    PROFILES ||--o{ ORDERS : "places"  
    LOCATIONS ||--o{ PROFILES : "staffs"  
    LOCATIONS ||--o{ ORDERS : "originates"  
    LOCATIONS ||--o{ LOCATION\_PRODUCTS : "accesses"  
    PRODUCTS ||--o{ LOCATION\_PRODUCTS : "listed\_in"  
      
    %% Templates & Mass Setup  
    SETUP\_TEMPLATES ||--o{ TEMPLATE\_ITEMS : "defines"  
    PRODUCTS ||--o{ TEMPLATE\_ITEMS : "contains"

    %% Unified Diet Logic (New in v2.2)  
    DIET\_CODES ||--o{ CATERING\_DETAILS : "defines\_primary\_diet"  
    DIET\_CODES ||--o{ ORDER\_DIETARY\_FLAGS : "defines\_flag"  
    ORDERS ||--o{ ORDER\_DIETARY\_FLAGS : "has\_restrictions"

    ORDERS ||--o{ ORDER\_ITEMS : "contains"  
    ORDERS ||--|| CATERING\_DETAILS : "clinical\_data"

    LOCATIONS {  
        int id PK  
        string name "Ward 6.2"  
        string responsible\_name "Nurse Unit Manager"  
        string approver\_email "cost\_center\_manager@hospital.com"  
    }

    PRODUCTS {  
        int id PK  
        string name "Full Cream Milk"  
        decimal unit\_price  
        boolean requires\_approval  
    }

    LOCATION\_PRODUCTS {  
        int location\_id PK  
        int product\_id PK  
        int par\_level "Ideal Stock Amount"  
        boolean is\_visible  
    }

    %% Master Table for Diets/Allergies  
    DIET\_CODES {  
        int id PK  
        string code "GF, DBT, NO-ONION"  
        string name "Gluten Free"  
        enum category "primary\_diet, allergy, dislike"  
        boolean is\_active  
    }

    ORDERS {  
        int id PK  
        enum type "grocery, catering, proactive\_restock"  
        enum status "pending, approved, processing, delivered"  
    }

    CATERING\_DETAILS {  
        int order\_id PK  
        int primary\_diet\_id FK "Links to DIET\_CODES"  
        string bed\_number  
        string other\_notes "Free text for rare cases"  
    }

    ORDER\_DIETARY\_FLAGS {  
        int order\_id PK  
        int diet\_code\_id PK "Links to DIET\_CODES (Allergy/Dislike)"  
    }

## **5\. Security & Compliance**

### **5.1. Row Level Security (RLS)**

Security is enforced at the database engine level, not just the frontend.

* **Nurse Role:** Can ONLY SELECT and INSERT orders where location\_id matches their assigned ward.  
* **Store Man Role:** Can SELECT all orders globally but only UPDATE status fields.  
* **Approval Flow:** Restricted items remain in pending\_approval state until a secure token is validated via the approver\_email.

## **6\. Implementation Roadmap**

### **Phase 1: Foundation (Weeks 1-2)**

* \[ \] Setup Supabase Project & Database Schema.  
* \[ \] Configure Auth & RLS Policies.  
* \[ \] Develop "Admin" panel to populate Products, Locations, and Diet Codes.

### **Phase 2: Core Ordering (Weeks 3-5)**

* \[ \] Build Nurse Dashboard (Groceries & Catering forms).  
* \[ \] Implement "Cut-off time" logic.  
* \[ \] Build "Dispatcher" Split-View for Kitchen.

### **Phase 3: Logistics Intelligence (Weeks 6-8)**

* \[ \] Develop Store Man Tablet Interface.  
* \[ \] Implement "Gap Analysis" algorithm.  
* \[ \] Integration Testing with Barcode Scanners.

### **Phase 4: Pilot & Training (Week 9\)**

* \[ \] Live Pilot in **Ward 6.2**.  
* \[ \] Staff Training.  
* \[ \] Full Hospital Rollout.
